S01: In the kingdom of frost, the ice walls glitter like precious stones. A shadow flies over them.
S02: It is no ordinary bird. It is Loki, the god of deceit, come to spy.
S03: From the ice palace, Loki observes the majestic fortress of the giants.
S04: But in the shadows a trap lurks. An enormous hand reaches from behind an ice pillar.
S05: The wicked Geroið seized Loki and locked him in a cage.
S07: Loki: "I know that you and my brother are not friends."
S08: Loki: "If you release me, I will bring Thor here — without his weapon."
S10: Finally free, Loki flies back to Asgard.
S11: In golden Asgard, Thor welcomes his brother.
S12: Loki: "Brother, what beautiful things I saw in the kingdom of the giants!"
S13: Loki: "It would be better to go without weapons — we shall be their guests."
S14: Thor leaves behind his hammer — from which he never parted.
S15: Without weapons or armor, the two brothers set out on the daunting road to the land of the giants.
S16: The road leads them through ever steeper lands, and the sky fills with heavy snow.
S17: The snowstorm seizes them with full force.
S18: They seek shelter in the cave of the giantess Grid.
S19: Grid: "I am a friend of Odin, your father. I will help you."
S20: Grid: "Geroið is a brute and I do not like him. Here is an iron glove — you will need it."
S21: Grid: "Take also this iron rod and the belt."
S22: With Grid's gifts, the brothers continue toward Geroið's palace.
S23: On the way they are met by a swift, raging river.
S24: In the river lurks Gjálp, the giant's daughter.
S25: Gjálp raises the river to drown them.
S26: Thor drives the iron rod deep into the riverbed.
S27: With the rod's strength, he braces against the current and pulls himself to the shore.
S28: Soon they arrive at the icy gates of Geroið's palace.
S29: They are greeted by Greip, Geroið's other daughter.
S30: Greip leads them through the guest hall and offers Thor a chair to sit.
S31: Greip: "Sit, Thor. Rest from the long road."
S32: Suddenly the ceiling begins to descend — Greip lifts the chair on her shoulders.
S33: Thor grabs the iron rod and strikes.
S34: The giantess stumbles and crashes to the floor, defeated.
S35: At that moment Geroið appears, with a glowing firebrand in his hand.
S36: Thor raises the iron glove and catches the white-hot brand.
S37: With all his might, Thor hurls it back at Geroið.
S38: The brand strikes the ice giant.
S39: The icy might of Geroið shatters and he falls, defeated.
S40: With the victory over Geroið, the brothers walk out of the ice palace.
S41: Thor strides proudly, and Loki is silent — but not from joy.
S42: Loki: "You succeeded... even without the hammer."
S43: Thor: "Strength is not in the hammer alone, brother."
S44: Ahead awaits the golden glow of Asgard.
S45: In Asgard, the hammer still lies where Thor left it.
S46: Thor raises his might again, and the hammer blazes with thunder.
S47: And Loki stands in the shadow, with a heart full of envy.
S48: Thus ends the tale of Thor and the ice giants — where strength lies in the heart, not in the weapon.
